notes.title: A General Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310072/688fc6218fcd353f8207f9a1918e41546a0e64ee.png:
-We made a new tutorial, where you can actually play around, rather than just read. This will hopefully make it easier to learn how to play
-We made it easier to invite friends to your game by adding a button that invites them.

Along with those features, we also fixed a few bugs:
-Fixed some major bugs in the 'best times' page that made it so some times weren't recorded.
-Fixed some bugs that allowed music to be played multiple times at once

notes.title: The Timer Update
notes.content:
The biggest update to Dash Shooters yet! Introducing the 'Best Times' page! Now you can see how fast you have completed the map with certain settings. 
There are 7 different settings that can change how fast you can complete a map, and in the 'Best Times' page, you can change those settings to see what your best times are for each of the settings!

There are over 2,800 different combinations of settings, so there are plenty of different settings to speedrun :).

More Features
-Made it so if you hit an obstacle, you get some dashes back, so you can get back to high speeds quicker!

Bug Fixes:
-Generates the map slightly earlier to fix some client issues
-Made the color selector text white so it is easier to read
-And more very minor bugs :)
